_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see applyMenuRelocations in main.js). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it, a child group targeting its own parent flattens). sections: menu-entry id -> section name (assigns a top-level leaf to a navigation section — `settings` renders it inside the NC gear-icon foldout, so genuinely-admin/config entries live under Settings instead of a duplicate top-level Administration group). removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links and e2e specs. Lives outside manifest.json because the app-manifest-v2 schema has additionalProperties:false at the root.

_settingsSectionNote: Promoted into the NC settings foldout (the bottom-left gear, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav) by applySettingsSection in main.js. Config/admin/integration/master-data-setup entries only; operational lists stay top-level. Pipelines (pipeline definitions/config), Integrations caption + BI export + CTI (integrations/connections), POS rollen + POS medewerkers (POS master-data/admin). KassakoppelingAuditList is an audit REPORT and stays in the main nav. AvgRequests (AVG/DSAR) is EARMARKED to move out of pipelinq later into OpenRegister's AVG/DSAR subsystem (admin-gated, different data model — a prior seam found pipelinq cannot cleanly consume it yet); kept under Settings until that OR seam lands. The MDM steward views (Master data / Duplicates / Sync queue / Trust configuration) have now MOVED to OpenRegister (ADR-045 #D): they are removed from pipelinq and replaced by a single 'MdmDataQuality' deep-link nav entry that opens OR's Data-Quality surface. That deep-link is relocated into the 'Reports & Compliance' group (AnalyticsGroup) via relocations rather than the settings foldout. RestartTutorial + its Help caption were dropped from the nav entirely (ADR-043): the walkthrough is re-run from the built-in 'Restart walkthrough' button in the User settings > Walkthrough modal (CnAppRoot), so the duplicate nav entry was redundant.
_removalsNote: IA revision 2026-07: the Service top-level entry and its ServiceHubOverview hub page are dropped. Its former service leaves (Requests→Tickets, Tasks, Contactmomenten, Complaints, Projects, MyWork, Queues) now live under Customer Support (KccWerkplek) as real nav children instead of hub cards; the booking domain (BookingsGroup: Services/Resources/Bookings) moves under Operational; the Sales & CRM leaves move under the Commercial dashboard (relabelled 'Sales'). All leaf page routes remain registered for deep-linking and e2e coverage (REQ-NAV-003).
